# INRISHI Partner Network

Canonical website: https://partner.inrishi.in/
Parent company: INRISHI PRIVATE LIMITED
Main company website: https://www.inrishi.in/

The INRISHI Partner Network allows approved partners to refer genuine business requirements for AI automation, CRM, employee management software and business websites. INRISHI handles solution scope, commercial discussion, implementation and support. Commercial incentive details remain private inside the authenticated Partner Portal.

Public partner page: https://partner.inrishi.in/
Partner Terms: https://partner.inrishi.in/partner-terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://partner.inrishi.in/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://partner.inrishi.in/terms.html

Authenticated login, registration and portal pages are not intended for search indexing.
